text: I sense a transition, perhaps from the enclosed clarity of a glass-walled room to the openness just outside. The scene bears the marks of modern architecture and anticipation—a fire extinguisher stands ready for emergency, while an intriguing room lies behind glass, filled with the quiet expectation of chairs and the glow of a projected screen. I feel as though I am on the threshold, physically and metaphorically, moving from one state of being to another. There is a hum of potential here, a reminder that beginnings often lie just past the borders of our comfort.
